device_configs.metro-hq-rtr:
! NetArchitect generated configuration
! Device: metro-hq-rtr
! Role: HQ router (ABR)
! Scenario: metro
! Lab credentials only; see README. Do not reuse in production.
!
hostname metro-hq-rtr
!
no ip domain-lookup
service timestamps debug datetime msec
service timestamps log datetime msec
!
enable secret NetArchitect-Lab-123
username admin privilege 15 secret NetArchitect-Lab-123
!
ip routing
!
! --- VLAN database ---
vlan 10
 name HQ-USERS
vlan 20
 name TRADING
vlan 30
 name REMOTEA-USERS
vlan 40
 name REMOTEB-USERS
vlan 50
 name COLO
!
! --- LAN trunk ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description LAN trunk
 no shutdown
!
! --- HQ-Users ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 description HQ-Users
 ip address 10.20.0.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
! --- Trading ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20
 description Trading
 ip address 10.20.1.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
! --- Colo ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.50
 description Colo
 ip address 10.20.2.129 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
!
! --- WAN link to RemoteA ---
interface Serial0/0/0
 description WAN link to RemoteA
 ip address 10.20.2.161 255.255.255.252
 clock rate 1544000
 service-policy output WAN-QOS
 no shutdown
!
! --- WAN link to RemoteB ---
interface Serial0/1/0
 description WAN link to RemoteB
 ip address 10.20.2.165 255.255.255.252
 clock rate 1544000
 service-policy output WAN-QOS
 no shutdown
!
!
! --- OSPF ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.20.0.1
 network 10.20.0.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.20.1.0 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 10.20.2.128 0.0.0.31 area 0
 network 10.20.2.160 0.0.0.3 area 0
 network 10.20.2.164 0.0.0.3 area 0
 passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20
 passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0.50
!
! --- QoS: priority queue for latency-sensitive traffic ---
class-map match-any TRADING-CLASS
 match access-group name TRADING-TRAFFIC
policy-map WAN-QOS
 class TRADING-CLASS
  priority percent 30
 class class-default
  fair-queue
!
ip access-list extended TRADING-TRAFFIC
 permit ip 10.20.1.0 0.0.0.127 any
!
ip access-list extended MGMT-ACCESS
 permit tcp 10.20.0.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 22
 deny ip any any
!
line con 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
 login local
 transport input ssh
 access-class MGMT-ACCESS in
!
end
